claims.text: In , Findegil wrote a copy of the Thain's Book for the Thain of the Shire, probably at the request of Peregrin Took's great-grandson. This copy was the only one to include Bilbo Baggins's complete Translations from the Elvish, which Bilbo had composed while at Rivendell during his 'retirement' there.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, "Prologue", "Note on the Shire Records", pp. 14-15
